action: Current and former TSMC employees: follow the company's notice, monitor bank accounts, and be alert to messages using your personal details. Other firms: ask your cloud and HR providers how employee data is protected.
exec: A supplier breach exposed staff data at a key chipmaker; the number of people affected has not been given.
plain: Chipmaker TSMC said a break-in at a cloud company it uses exposed information about current and former employees. A hacker claims to hold 6.9GB including identity, contact and banking details.
summary: TSMC disclosed that a breach at a cloud provider exposed data on current and former employees. A hacker claimed on November 8 to hold 6.9GB including IDs, contacts and banking details. TSMC has not given a record count.
title: TSMC employee data exposed through third-party cloud provider

validation.note: One tracker so far; company statement not yet read directly.
